title: Login Form Generator
description: Generate a styled login form — labels, remember-me, show/hide password — with live preview and HTML/CSS.
howto: Set the form title, subtitle and button text.
Toggle remember-me, forgot-password and social buttons.
Pick the accent color and theme.
Copy the code or download the self-contained login.html.

faqs.q: Does the form actually log anyone in?
faqs.a: No — it is front-end markup and styles. Wire the <form> action to your own backend or auth provider.

faqs.q: How does the show/hide password work?
faqs.a: The included JavaScript toggles the password field type between password and text.
Yes — every input has a real <label>, and the form uses autocomplete attributes.

faqs.q: Can I embed it in my page?
faqs.a: Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with lf- to avoid collisions.
